maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mostly recurring inflight connectivity service plans for business aviation, plus equipment sales; not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are business jet owners, operators and charter fleets paying privately; military/government is a smaller segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own connectivity products and services; Satcom Direct was one large deal, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Installed avionics hardware, STC-certified installs and secure datalink make switching costly, involving re-installation, downtime and certification.
